01 / START WITH YOUR RECORDS

Bring your actual enquiries.

No customer records loaded. No example customers are included.

What this checks

Who is responsible? Is a first response recorded? Is the agreed next action overdue? Does a past appointment have a recorded outcome?

A missing response timestamp means history needs checking. It does not prove the customer was ignored or that a deal was lost.

CSV fields and supported statuses

Required: id, type, received_at, status.
Optional: reference, assignee, response_at, next_action_at, appointment_at, source.

Type: residential, multifamily or management.
Status: new, contacted, appointment, won, closed, opted_out.

Dates need an explicit timezone, for example 2026-10-09T09:00:00-04:00. Up to 5,000 records. If your CRM export has different fields, its activity history needs mapping before using these checks.

Records stay in memory until this page is closed or reloaded. Export your working copy. No mailbox, CRM or calendar is connected.
